Ultra Blend is 70% coffee and 30% chicory, which means it behaves exactly the way most Indian households expect their morning cup to behave — strong enough to stand up to a generous pour of milk and sugar, but gentle enough that you can drink a second cup without the jitters. Flip the jar over and find the ingredient list. That is the only line that matters.
